Keke Long

Dr. Long is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering at Rutgers University–New Brunswick. Dr. Long studies how to improve the safety and reliability of transportation systems.

Dr. Long has served as co-PI on federally funded transportation research project and instructor of CCAT certificate program. Her research develops AI-based methods that use physical knowledge to improve interpretability and adaptation to changing conditions. She validates these methods through simulation, digital twins, and real-vehicle experiments to support the reliable deployment of automated transportation systems. She has published over 30 papers including Transportation Research Part A/C/E and IEEE ITS/ITSM.
